announcement: Your Mission Cosuno is a B2B marketplace connecting general contractors and subcontractors across the construction industry. As our Senior Lifecycle & Retention Manager, you'll build the growth engine that turns new users into active, paying and retained customers — and move us toward an AI-native, signal-driven system that decides what happens next on its own. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup. What you’ll do You build the CRM programmes and lifecycle journeys that drive adoption and conversion — from first tender discovery to paid conversion for subcontractors, and early product adoption to repeat tendering for construction companies. Together with the Marketing Lead, you build an agentic, signal-driven system that turns behavioural data, call insights and enrichment signals into personalised next-best-action triggers — replacing static journeys with ones that decide what happens next on their own. You experiment and measure with A/B tests and holdout groups, so decisions are based on incremental impact, not campaign output. You scale what works into a repeatable system, not one-off campaigns. You connect journeys with Sales and Customer Success, handing off to a human touch when that's more effective than automation. You use CRM as a lever for marketplace liquidity — getting the right subcontractors onto the right tenders — and orchestrate email, in-app, transactional comms and marketplace recommendations as one journey with Product. You support growth programmes such as referrals — from design through CRM execution. What You Bring You've owned CRM, lifecycle, retention or growth programmes and can show the commercial impact they created — ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business model. You've directly influenced conversion, activation or retention metrics and are confident with data and experimentation. You're genuinely AI-native: proven experience building AI-driven automation or agentic CRM systems, not just using AI to write copy faster. You write and run SQL queries independently. A plus: hands-on experience with ActiveCampaign and Salesforce (or comparable CRM tools). Fluent in written and spoken German and English. AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval. Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours. Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro. A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events. Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.
